content: Satanasnen Jesus tanahi
Jaa pecaho ta jano tsoabi yamahi janin Dios Yoshiman Jesus hionishqui. Jordan huean janinhax cahchiho jan canon, hioquin, janoxon sca tiroma yoshiman jahuen shinan tananon.
Jano cuarenta neten piyamabahinaxon piyamashinahax hihti picatsihscai.
Hihti picatsihscaiya ta tiroma yoshin sca joxon yohinishqui, hohchamacatsihquin: —Papa Diosen baque hihxon, toa macan toncobo yohihue, piticahinscanon —hahquin.
—Papan huisha janin ta nea joi jaiqui: Piti res jaax jihuetima tah man jai. Papan yohihi joi jatihibi nincaqui jihuenahue hih ta Papa janishqui —Jesusen jaquin.
Jaatian ta Jerusalen janin sca tiroma yoshiman hionishqui, Papa yocati xobo janin. Xobo mamacanya manimaxon sca yohiquin:
—Papa Diosen baque hihquish, naman paquehue. Jahuen huisha janin ta Papan yohihiqui:

content.text: Jahuen yonotibaan ta mia coirantihiqui. Jaton mequemanbi ta mia bihinihnicantihiqui, macan qui min joxcorohyamanon

content: —hahquin yoshiman.
—Huetsa Papan quirica janin ta nea jaiqui: Hea cahra hahxoncointihiquin hihxon miin Hihbo Dios tanayamahue —hahquin Jesusen.
Jaatian, tiroma yoshiman boribiquin, queya mahchi janin sca. Manimaxon sca hocho jismaquin jatihibi jemabo jan jisnon. Jaton jahuaborayabi jato jismaquin. Jismaxon yohiquin:
—Min hehqui raboxonen tisquihahpaquehiya tah hen jaa jatihibi mia hinantihi —hahquin.
—Catanhue, Satanas. Papan huisha janin ta nea joi jaiqui: Miin Hihbo Dios huesti qui tah min raboxonen tisquihahpaquetihi. Jaa huesti tah min nincatihi —Jesusen jaquin.
Jascajaquin yohihah ta tiroma yoshin caresscanishqui. Jaa xahbanen cahen Papan yonotibo nocohihnati. Nocohihnaxon, piti hinancanquin.
Galilea mainxon Jesusen jato yohimenohi
Cahchihoh quehax joxon, quiquin hapon sontarobaan Juan bichipi joi nincacax, Galilea main sca Jesus cahi jahui.
Nazaret jema janinhax Capernaum jema janinbo sca baneti cahi, hian quexa. Jano Zabulonbo betan Neftalíbo jihuetaibo janin jihuetahbahi.
Jaa copi ta Papan joi yohinica Isaíasnen yohini quescanishqui:

content.text: Zabulon mai janinhahbon, Neftalí mai janinhahbon, jaton hian janin jaibo rihbi Jordan huean hoque quexa jihuetaibon, Galilea main jihuetai judiomabon,
Bahquish chian jihuetaibaan bi ta hani xaba jiscannishqui. Mahuati qui raquetaibaanbi ta xaba paquenishqui, mahuapan jato bihpanan

content: hihqui jaa huisha.
Jano ta Jesusen yohimenonishqui: —Maton shinan pontemabo potaxon shinan siribo bihnahue. Papan mato jihuemati nete ta nea pishca sca jaonahiqui —hahquin.
Yapa bihnicahbo Jesus betan cahi
Jaatian sca Galilea hian quetanbahini caquin bi tarrafa pota potahi joni rabe meraquin. Huetsa, Simon. Huetsa, jahuen jochica Andres. Yapa bihnica rabe.
—Hehbetanbi bonahue, jonibo sca hen mato tsinquimanon —jato jaquin.
Yohihah ta jaton tarrafa jenebahini caquin chibanbahincannishqui, hahbetanbi sca nichi.

Caribixon sca huetsa rabe rihbi meraquin. Jacobo betan jahuen jochica Juan, Zebedeonen baque rabe. Jaton papa betan nontinxon jaton tarrafa hona honahiton jato merabonaquin. Jaabo rabe sca jascajaribiquin yohiquin.
Jan yohihah, jacahini caquin jaton papaya jaton nonti jenebahinxon Jesus chibanrihbicanquin.
Jonibo Jesusen haxemahi

Galilea mai janinbo yohihi cahi ta bocannishqui. Jema qui nocotax judiobaan tsinquiti xoboho hihcoxon Papan joi jato honanmaquin. Papan jato jihuemati nete nea pishca sca jaonahi yohixon, hisinaibo jatihibi rohajaxon, yosmabo rohajaxon coshi jato hinanquin, Jesusen.

Jato honanmaxon rohajahiya ta hocho bi res Siria maibo janin jatihibi jaya yohuanchanicannishqui, jano jihuetaibo. Jaa copi ta jaa janin jaton hisinyahpabo hiocannishqui, hihti hisin tenehibo, mesco hisinyahpabo, mahua hisinyahpabo, tiroma yoshiman hihbojahibo, mapo masataibo, yora honanyamajaquetaibo rihbi. Jaa rahsiya behiboya jato rohajaquin.
Hihti caibo sca jaa chibani becani, Galilea mai mehabo, Decápolis jemabo janinhahbo, Jerusalen janinhahbo, Judea mai mehabo, Jordan huean hoque quexa quehabo rihbi.
